exclusions.title: Texas project: seventh image is a ceiling detail
exclusions.reason: All seven project images were reviewed. Six show the specified Dried Thyme siding and are included. The remaining image mainly shows a porch ceiling; its precise paint color is not separately specified, so it is linked here rather than counted as a body-color reference.

exclusions.title: Proposed paint, drawings and recoloring discussions
exclusions.reason: This owner names Dried Thyme for a planned house, but the attached images are drawings and mockups. Other Houzz and Reddit suggestion threads similarly do not prove a completed paint application.

exclusions.title: Pontata reposts and an untraceable additional image
exclusions.reason: The identifiable exterior photos repeat PLAN Home compositions. A further generic close exterior image had no recoverable original project or convincing documentation of actual paint, so it is omitted.

exclusions.title: Swatches, palette diagrams and unrelated paint brands
exclusions.reason: The Dried Thyme illustration here is a palette strip. Color chips, manufacturer option catalogs, HOA schedules and architectural specifications are not photographs of completed paint jobs. Behr Dried Thyme ICC-57 is a different paint and is excluded.

exclusions.title: Duplicate sizes, crops and before photographs
exclusions.reason: Removed repeated compositions from Pinterest, PLAN Home and Pontata, the tight crop of the Berea front photo, the repeated Stone Painting image, Hilltop before photos, and Berea white/red before photos. Different viewpoints, seasonal images and explicitly labeled work stages remain.

exclusions.title: Limits of public social attribution
exclusions.reason: Several real photos have a credited social account and a clear published color label, but their original owner or painter caption was not recovered. They remain secondary attributions; the gallery does not promote them to source-confirmed projects.

methodology: Searched public text and image results with Dried Thyme, Sherwin-Williams, SW 6186/SW6186, exterior, siding, stucco, house, painting, before/after, homeowner, porch, door and shutter terms. Checked contractor portfolios, homeowner discussions, public social captions and carousels, Houzz project albums and paint answers, manufacturer posts, Pinterest, design articles and reference databases. Expanded the 25-photo Paint Color Consultants gallery and reviewed all seven Texas project views and all four original Grey Wolf carousel photographs. Visually inspected retained photographs and removed known duplicate files, crops and reposts. A source-confirmed label means an original project professional or owner names the paint; it is not laboratory verification of paint or camera color. Secondary body attributions and exterior accents have separate categories. One unverified Craftsman lead is outside the 39-photo main count. Some photos show only a detail, shade, partial obstruction or an unfinished work stage, as labeled. Source groups are not a census of unique houses, and image counts are not house counts. No recoloring or AI-generated images were introduced. This is a thorough public-web collection, not a guarantee of every photograph ever posted. Private, deleted, unindexed, login-restricted or inaccessible material may contain additional images.
